rules.name: Patient Test Barcode Tracking
rules.description: Every lab specimen must be linked with a unique barcode/QR code.
rules.recommendation: Assign a unique specimen barcode matching the patient test requisition.

rules.name: Doctor Verification Before Release
rules.description: Lab test results cannot be printed or emailed without pathologist digital signoff.
rules.recommendation: Require doctor/pathologist credentials and timestamp before marking report as ready.
